source: skills/*/SKILL.md (names); each role is one sentence in our own words; seats as the building's rule 0

skills.name: data-sourcing
skills.role: Plans which filings and reports each company needs and searches for missing operating figures.

skills.name: financial-modeling
skills.role: Calibrates the driver model against history and writes the workbook and its JSON twin.

skills.name: fs-driver-decomposition
skills.role: Breaks the statements into operating drivers such as volume, price and cost per unit.

skills.name: fs-intake
skills.role: Reads the filings into a standard chart of accounts and checks that every line ties to its source.

skills.name: fs-normalize
skills.role: Adjusts reported figures for one-off and non-operating items, with each adjustment evidenced.

skills.name: fs-reverse-engineering
skills.role: Runs the pipeline: moves each company through the stages in order, keeps the gates and budgets, and records every transition.

skills.name: guruh
skills.role: Learns from review findings and proposes changes to the skills, which only the owner approves.

skills.name: idx-universe
skills.role: Chooses which listed companies go into a wave, one pair per sub-industry, and records why.

skills.name: peer-benchmark
skills.role: Builds ranges for each driver from the companies in the same sub-industry.

skills.name: review-manager
skills.role: Reviews the work at each of the three gates, writes review notes and escalates what only the owner can decide.

skills.name: partner
skills.role: The owner: decides escalations and proposals, and approves a model for publication.
